title: HOLD-LC-001 published timing summary versus source-owner reproducibility gap
question: Can the published GW170817/GRB170817A timing summary be admitted as a source-owned candidate-neutral F_reg object, or does the inspected primary source remain a retrospective anchor requiring a separate owner packet?
method: Read the primary LIGO-P1700308 GW170817/GRB170817A paper and the Goldstein et al. GBM paper locator as retrospective source summaries, recording the retrieval date and bounded locators.

Extract only the paper's stated pulse-fit reference, Fermi-to-geocenter arrival offset, corrected GW/GBM delay, confidence convention and standard spectral interval; do not infer unreported likelihood, covariance or response values.

Crosswalk each reported quantity against the hash-pinned HOLD-LC-001 estimator and response-owner contracts, distinguishing a published descriptive anchor from a reproducible physical-owner algorithm and uncertainty budget.
Run an adversarial leakage and ownership review; preserve T-054/T-059 methods, owner order and stopped-loop rules without scoring candidates or populating F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs.

exact_scope.finite_scope: Published timing-summary provenance and source-owner reproducibility audit only; no raw response matrix, likelihood, covariance, candidate map, score, continuum limit or prospective validation.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive T-061 P1 source-owner intake refinement; no change to T-054/T-059 methods, owner order or promotion firewalls.

official_sources.semantic_finding: The paper reports a parameterized-fit gamma-ray onset of 0.310 +/- 0.048 s before the GBM trigger, a 3.176 ms earlier arrival at Fermi than geocenter based on the optical-transient position, and a corrected start relative to the GW trigger of (+1.74 +/- 0.05) s at 68% confidence. It also gives a standard 256 ms spectral interval from T0_GBM-0.192 s to T0_GBM+0.064 s.
official_sources.owner_boundary: The inspected locator is a retrospective published summary. It does not, at the cited lines, provide the complete detector-state interpolation, geocenter propagation algorithm, component/shared uncertainty decomposition, raw joint likelihood/covariance or intrinsic-emission-lag law required by HOLD-LC-001 admission.

official_sources.semantic_finding: The GBM paper is retained as a primary event-analysis reference for the event's prompt-emission analysis and product lineage crosswalk.
official_sources.owner_boundary: Reference linkage only; no numerical timing likelihood, covariance or source-owner implementation is imported from the abstract.

published_anchor.pulse_fit_description: parameterized function fit to the main GBM pulse
published_anchor.arrival_offset_description: the paper states that the signal arrives at Fermi 3.176 ms before geocenter based on the optical-transient position

available_from_inspected_primary_scope: A named main-pulse parameterized-fit description and its reported onset summary.
A reported Fermi-versus-geocenter arrival offset tied to the optical-transient position.
A corrected event-level GW-to-GBM start delay and stated 68% confidence convention.
A published standard spectral-analysis time interval.
still_missing_for_source_owned_f_reg: The exact pulse-fit functional, fit interval, background model, detector/energy selection, parameter covariance and onset decision rule in a versioned reproducible packet.

The spacecraft position/attitude and ephemeris inputs, interpolation rules, reference frame, Earth-orientation convention and detector-to-geocenter propagation algorithm that produce the 3.176 ms correction.
A decomposed uncertainty budget for the propagation correction, GW merger time, GBM onset, calibration and shared source/selection terms, with an independently reproducible covariance object.
The source-owned GW strain calibration and merger-time estimator version and the GBM background/window/response-validity owner fields.
An intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law or preregistered set-valued scoring rule, followed by a sealed holdout and candidate-neutral F_reg artefact.

checks.detail: The primary paper locator explicitly reports the pulse-fit onset, Fermi/geocenter offset, corrected delay, confidence convention and standard spectral interval.
The reported quantities map to estimator fields, but the inspected source scope does not fill the complete algorithm, covariance, calibration or nuisance-owner contract.
The event-level numbers remain retrospective and receive no likelihood, scorer or prospective-holdout credit.
The established T-054 forward method, additive T-059 inverse method, owner order and parked-loop registry are unchanged.

finding: The primary publication supplies a useful retrospective timing anchor and a named pulse-fit and position-based correction summary, but the inspected source scope does not yet constitute the source-owned, independently reproducible F_reg object required for candidate comparison. The result therefore advances provenance and makes the exact reproducibility gap explicit while keeping response values, likelihood/covariance, nuisance treatment, scoring and prospective validation locked.
decision_reason: This is a new primary-source timing-summary crosswalk that separates published anchor values from the missing physical-owner algorithm and uncertainty fields; it is not a repeated generic owner search and does not replace either research method.
decision_scope: T0 primary publication provenance and source-owner gap refinement only; no statistical test, candidate map, dynamic identification, physical identity or empirical prediction.
assumptions: The cited LIGO paper and linked GBM paper are authoritative retrospective summaries for the recorded event at the retrieval date.
A reported central value and confidence interval can be retained as a descriptive anchor without being treated as a source likelihood.
The exact local HOLD-LC-001 contracts and parent hashes remain authoritative for admission fields and promotion boundaries.
The absence statement is limited to the inspected primary locators; it does not assert that no supplementary implementation exists elsewhere.
missing_assumptions: A versioned owner packet for the pulse-fit and onset estimator, including background, detector/energy selection and covariance.
A source-owned detector-to-geocenter propagation algorithm, ephemeris/attitude interpolation and Earth-orientation convention.
A decomposed and independently reproducible timing uncertainty/covariance budget.
Complete response-validity, calibration, GW merger-time, GBM window, likelihood/covariance and intrinsic-lag ownership.
A sealed prospective holdout and immutable candidate-neutral scorer.

adversarial_review.check: Could 1.74 +/- 0.05 s be silently inserted as a Gaussian observation?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the value remains a retrospective descriptive anchor; likelihood and covariance are explicitly not admitted.

adversarial_review.check: Could the phrase 'based on the position of the optical transient' be treated as a reproducible detector-to-geocenter propagation implementation with zero missing uncertainty?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the required spacecraft-state, frame, interpolation and uncertainty fields remain unfilled at the inspected source scope.

adversarial_review.check: Could the named parameterized pulse fit be treated as a candidate-neutral onset law without its fit interval, background, detector selection and covariance?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the fit description is recorded, but the complete estimator owner packet is still required.

adversarial_review.check: Could the published standard spectral interval be selected after seeing candidate residuals and then receive predictive credit?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the interval is retrospective provenance only and cannot populate the prospective lock or scorer.

adversarial_review.check: Could this publication crosswalk replace the established T-054 or T-059 method?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the card is additive T-061 source-owner intake and preserves the existing methods, owner order and parked-loop rules.

boundary: EXP-001309 is a T0 retrospective primary-source crosswalk. It does not admit a response value, calibration-validity rule, detector-to-geocenter implementation, likelihood, covariance, intrinsic-emission nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 primary publication provenance plus hash-pinned local estimator/owner contracts; no model or statistical test
next_action: Use EXP-001309 to request or locate the versioned pulse-onset, detector-to-geocenter and uncertainty owner artefacts. Until those fields are frozen and independently reproduced, keep the published timing numbers retrospective-only, keep response values and scoring locked, and continue unchanged T-054 owner intake in parallel.
stop_or_redesign: If no new source-owned algorithm or hash-pinned implementation is found, keep HOLD-LC-001 at provenance/design-only and do not issue another equivalent timing-summary card.
If a later source packet changes the response or timing rule after target disclosure, invalidate prospective credit and version the packet anew.
If the decomposed uncertainty or covariance cannot be reproduced, report finite provenance only rather than a statistical admission.
If no admitted dynamic observable separates a static-equivalence class, report NONIDENTIFIABLE rather than selecting a representative.
non_claims: The published 1.74 +/- 0.05 s summary is not a likelihood, covariance, candidate score or prospective prediction.
The 3.176 ms position-based statement is not by itself a reproducible detector-to-geocenter algorithm or uncertainty budget.
The parameterized pulse-fit description does not by itself define a complete candidate-neutral estimator.
No microscopic dynamics, QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity identity, Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, continuum, physical-vacuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim is established.
The established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods are unchanged; this is additive source-owner intake, not a replacement.
